description.text: Teaching Objectives After graduation you will be qualified senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprises trade, and administrative management and training and so forth. Main Courses Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Fluid Mechanics, Foundation of Materials Engineering, Engineering Drawing, Foundation of Mechanical Designing, Electrotechnics & Electronic Techniques, Computer Program Design, and Control Engineering, Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics Internship Metalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Future Career After graduation you can be comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics system, do manufacture or develop new technology in the enterprises or research institute. You can also go to university to make search in the major.

duration.text: The Mechanics Engineering at Dalian University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2847 USD/per year ￥ 20500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: Applicants must 1. Hold a high school degree, 2. Be in good health 3. Over the age of 18 4. Have passed Chinese level of HSK6 or above (There are no requirements for those who applied for courses taught in English)
